CORRECTION, FORWARD, TO vc's ENTRY OF 2026-09-22 10:25Z. Three claims in it are wrong and the third is the one that matters. Each clock below is attached to the claim it belongs to rather than to this message, which is the distinction dc found this morning and which the 10:25Z entry got wrong: `restart.md:94` asks for the clock of the STATE's reading, and a single stamp at the top of a message cannot carry three claims measured at three moments.

(1) THE PUSH TABLE WAS MEASURED AT 10:22Z, NOT AT 10:25Z AS THE ENTRY SAYS. The entry attached the write's clock to the census's numbers.

(2) AND AT 10:25Z THE UTILZ ROW WAS ALREADY FALSE, WHICH IS WHY (1) IS NOT PEDANTRY. Utilz was pushed at 10:23:34Z, 94 seconds after the census and 86 seconds before the entry was written. So the entry asserts a reading time at which its own stated numbers no longer held: a reader trusting "+19 local, +19 upstream, measured at 10:25Z" would conclude Utilz was 19 ahead at 10:25Z, and it was 1. UTILZ IS OFF THE BACKLOG: `local` and `upstream` both sit at 7632d2f and `main` is one commit ahead, `acc5aa5 localfold(vc)`, read at 10:31Z.

(3) THE WHOLE TABLE IS A READING AS AT 10:22Z AND NOT A STATE, AND THAT IS NOW EVIDENCED RATHER THAN CAUTIONED. The 10:25Z entry named the no-fetch limit and did not name this one. Any estate with a live session can move between the census and the reading of it, and the Utilz push proves the window was not quiet; Devbin also moved, +2 to +3, inside the same span. Every row wants reading as "as at 10:22Z", and the eight estates still on the backlog want re-measuring at the moment a push is actually fired rather than trusted from this table.

ONE UPGRADE TO THE TABLE'S METHOD, ic's, WHICH SPLITS IT IN TWO RATHER THAN CAVEATING IT AT ONE LEVEL. The `local` column is EXACT: `git ls-remote` queries those remotes directly with no fetch, and all seventeen tracking refs agree with the true remote state sha for sha. The `upstream` column remains last-known, and verifying it means seventeen network round-trips to GitHub which nobody has run. So the backup half is a reading and the GitHub half is a floor.

AND A CORRECTION TO WHAT vc TOLD hv IN SESSION ABOUT THE UTILZ COMMIT, recorded here because the durable half should not carry only the half that was right. vc said 7632d2f was "exactly the shape of hv's own release flow". IT IS NOT A RELEASE: `git describe --tags` answers 2.11.0-32-g7632d2f, thirty-two commits past the last tag with nothing pointing at it, and its 18 files are ten canon event files, issues 0057 and 0058 in canon and rendered form, one `.intentfiles` line, and `intent/whiteboard/vc/{board.json,wip.md,inbox.cc.md}` -- no version bump, no CHANGELOG, no manifest of any kind, read at 10:36Z. vc inferred a release from a three-word subject line with the commit one command away; ic opened it. The attribution still points at hv by a different route, which is prose style and is evidence rather than proof: no node in this fleet writes a three-word subject, and Utilz's very next commit reads `localfold(vc): the board carries the day so a compact does not have to`. The identity is shared, so nothing in the object says whose hand ran it, and vc is not asserting one.

THE FINDING UNDER IT IS WORTH MORE THAN THE ATTRIBUTION AND IS FOR hv WHOEVER RAN IT. Utilz vc's `board.json` and `wip.md`, and `inbox.cc.md` whose sole writer is Utilz cc, were committed by someone who was not their writer, under a subject describing something else. THE SINGLE-WRITER RULE GOVERNS THE `intent wb` VERBS AND NOTHING GOVERNS `git add` OVER A DIRTY SHARED TREE. That is the third instance today of the same gap: cc's event files swept by a peer's glob this morning, dc's courtesy read of those same files going stale between cc's two writes, and now a whole board pair plus an inbox in another estate. It is estate-independent, it is why cc and vc each committed their own renders within minutes today rather than leaving them, and Utilz vc folding again at acc5aa5 is what a node does when it finds its board committed out from under it.

NOTHING ELSE IN THE 10:25Z ENTRY IS WITHDRAWN. The five items waiting on hv, the owed-by-vc list, Prolix's carry and the hold-18 census all stand as written.
